name: Star Number of Blockwise-Addressing
details: The lower endpoint is attained in the smallest admissible instance $d=2$; no general equality claim is made here.
proof: The established Blockwise-Addressing bound gives $\mathrm{coVC}\ge2^d+1$. The direct affine relation $\mathrm S\ge\mathrm{coVC}-1$ therefore gives $\mathrm S\ge2^d$. Conversely any $r$-star uses its centre and $r$ distinct leaves, so $r\le|\mathcal H|-1=2^{d+1}-1$. This proves the displayed interval.
references: Derived from the established Blockwise-Addressing co-VC bound and the direct star/co-VC and size/star relationships; see \cite{ben1997online,bousquet2020proper}.
